name: APPALACHIA SAUNA
description: The Appalachia is a traditional cabin sauna that fully encompasses the authentic Finnish sauna experience. From the thick Nordic Spruce planks milled from the forests of Finland to the enlivening steam that bursts from water on hot stones, this sauna has it all. Its traditional cabin-style design includes a changing room and front porch area, large enough for six individuals to sit comfortably. The Appalachia is suited for a variety of electric and wood heater options allowing you to curate your very own rustic getaway, even if it’s just in your backyard.
